purpose: Design-only register for bounded company decision pilots that may begin only after external qualification.
boundary: No company data is connected by this register. A pilot cannot move to approved_test while its external candidate is held.

pilots.decision_question: Does a specific company workflow show measurable delay, repeat effort, absence, or retention differences consistent with an externally qualified time/care constraint pattern?

internal_data_contract.unmatched_case_policy: Report unmatched, suppressed, missing, and incompatible records separately; never drop them silently.

pilots.hypothesis: After external qualification, a pre-specified company workflow may show a bounded association between time/care constraints and task completion, delay, repeat effort, absence, or retention.
pilots.falsifier: No measurable difference under the pre-specified comparison, a reversed direction, or a stronger explanation unrelated to the proposed time/care mechanism.

privacy_and_rights.access_basis: Pending named data owner and lawful access review
privacy_and_rights.redistribution_limit: No connection, export, or decision use before approval

pilots.next_action: Finish the external candidate gates and select a named company workflow only after a qualified trend is recorded.
